title: Source EPI indicator weights — ingest epi2024weights.csv and rebuild gold_dim_indicator so Weighted EPI Score renders a 0-100 value
description:
Surfaced by the task-055 AC4 spot-check (2026-08-04): Weighted EPI Score renders BLANK in the deployed semantic model because gold_dim_indicator.weight is NULL for all 73 rows (weight_count_nonblank=0). Root cause: silver-to-gold2.Notebook builds gold_dim_indicator via a fallback path (L1136-1157) that hardcodes weight=F.lit(None) because the expected silver_epi{EPI_YEAR}variables table is never built — bronze_ingest_epi downloads only epi2024results.csv, not the variables/weights files. The fallback also flattens `type` to 'indicator' for all rows, losing the EPI / PolicyObjective / IssueCategory / Indicator hierarchy. PRE-EXISTING (git 193f8f2~1 confirms the pre-task-055 measure also used RELATED(weight)); NOT a task-055 regression. task-055's abbrev<>'EPI' double-count fix is correct DAX but moot until weights are sourced.

Fix shape (bronze → silver → gold → redeploy → re-spot-check): Yale publishes epi2024weights.csv (~5 KB) with the full hierarchy: Type (EPI/PolicyObjective/IssueCategory/Indicator), Abbreviation, Weight (relative within parent), NextLevel (parent pointer), and EPI Percent (absolute contribution to the EPI composite — the weight the measure needs for leaf indicators). (1) Bronze: extend bronze_ingest_epi to also download epi2024weights.csv → bronze_epi_weights. (2) Gold: rebuild gold_dim_indicator from the ingested weights — preserve real `type`, populate `weight` = EPI Percent for leaf indicators (Type=Indicator) and NULL for aggregates (EPI composite, PolicyObjective, IssueCategory), set parent_indicator from NextLevel. Retire/supersede the NULL-weight fallback path so the primary path runs against real data. (3) Optionally harden the Weighted EPI Score measure (fact_epi_score.tmdl) to filter type='Indicator' (leaf indicators only) for robustness — not strictly required because aggregates drop out via NULL weight, but explicit is safer than relying on NULL-weight exclusion. (4) Rerun gold, push → fabric-cicd redeploy, re-spot-check via Power BI REST + Erik's Power BI visual.

With leaf-only weights, task-055's measure is confirmed correct: the EPI composite + PO + IC aggregates contribute score*NULL and drop out of both numerator and denominator, leaving a weighted average of the ~58 leaf indicators by EPI Percent = the true EPI composite.
acceptanceCriteria: bronze_ingest_epi downloads epi2024weights.csv and writes it to a bronze table (bronze_epi_weights or silver_epi{EPI_YEAR}variables built from variables+weights) with the source columns: Type, Abbreviation, Variable, Weight, NextLevel, IssueCategory, PolicyObjective, EPI Percent. Verified: the table exists in the lakehouse and has ~73 rows (1 EPI + 2 PolicyObjective + 11 IssueCategory + ~58 Indicator).

gold_dim_indicator is rebuilt from the ingested weights (the NULL-hardcoding fallback path in silver-to-gold2 L1136-1157 is retired or superseded so the primary path runs against real data). The deployed gold_dim_indicator has: `type` with the 4 real values (EPI/PolicyObjective/IssueCategory/Indicator), `weight` populated = EPI Percent for leaf indicators (Type=Indicator) and NULL for aggregates, `parent_indicator` populated from NextLevel. Verified via the deployed semantic model (Power BI REST executeQueries): weight_count_nonblank > 0 (was 0); leaf-indicator rows have non-null weights; EPI composite + PO + IC rows have NULL weights; COUNT(DISTINCT type) = 4.

Weighted EPI Score renders a non-blank value in the 0-100 range in the deployed semantic model (verified via Power BI REST executeQueries after redeploy). Sanity anchor: Avg EPI Score = 46.95; the weighted score must be a plausible weighted average of leaf-indicator EPI scores — not blank, not >100, not structurally impossible. task-055's abbrev<>'EPI' filter is confirmed correct now that weights are leaf-only (PO/IC aggregates drop out via NULL weight).

Erik-gated Fabric attestation: push → fabric-cicd Deploy Fabric Artifacts workflow green; Erik spot-checks the Power BI report — Weighted EPI Score renders a sensible 0-100 value AND EPI Coverage / Countries with EPI Data still render (unchanged, since they consume abbrev='EPI' not weight). Run /work complete task-056 to attest. Update external_data_automation.md to reflect that the weights file is now ingested (the doc's download_epi_data() design listed it as unimplemented).
notes:
[VERIFICATION FAIL #1] CRITICAL: silver build casts EPI Percent (string '3.00%') to FloatType without stripping '%'; with ANSI off (Fabric parity) this silently NULLs all 58 leaf weights -> Weighted EPI Score renders 0/BLANK. AC2/AC3 NOT met. Implementer's 11/11 local assertions passed only because the fixture pre-converted EPI Percent to numeric (3.0, not '3.00%'), masking the real-CSV parsing failure. Verify-agent fetched the real Yale CSV and re-derived: weight_nonnull on leaf rows = 0/58. FIX: (1) strip '%': F.regexp_replace(F.col("`EPI Percent``"), "%", "").cast(FloatType()); (2) NULL for non-leaf: F.when(F.col('Type')=='Indicator', <stripped>).otherwise(F.lit(None).cast(FloatType())) — real CSV has non-null EPI Percent on all 11 IC rows, so the IC-NULL claim was wrong; the measure works via the type='Indicator' filter, not via NULL IC weights. Also minor: external_data_automation.md L123 stray ``` fence. Verified-correct parts: bronze download+schema, EPI Percent backtick escaping, NextLevel self-join (root NULL, MKP->BDH, no cartesian), unionByName, fallback guard (loud warn+empty, not symptom suppression), TMDL retains abbrev<>"EPI" + new type="Indicator", dax_measure_library matches TMDL, delimiter structure intact, no src/ mirror affected, AC4 correctly flagged Erik-gated (no push/deploy claim).

CREATED 2026-08-04 (/work) from the task-055 AC4 spot-check finding. Weighted EPI Score rendered BLANK in the deployed model (queried via Power BI REST executeQueries against OEMInsightBI_v2 after the 193f8f2 push + green fabric-cicd deploy). Root cause: gold_dim_indicator.weight is NULL for all 73 rows. gold data shape is otherwise correct: 73 EPI indicators (1 composite abbrev='EPI' + 72 sub = 2 PO + 11 IC + ~58 indicators), 180 countries with EPI data, 12016 sub-indicator fact rows + 180 composite rows, Avg EPI Score = 46.95, Countries with EPI Data = 180. | WHY owner=both AND Claude can act first: ACs 1-3 are code (bronze notebook + gold notebook + optional measure) + REST verification against the deployed model — Claude can implement and verify via the Fabric API (az token + Power BI REST executeQueries, as used in the spot-check). AC4 is Erik-gated (push + Power BI visual spot-check). Same shape as task-054 / task-055. | WEIGHTS SOURCE (verified 2026-08-04): https://epi.yale.edu/downloads/epi2024weights.csv — header: Type,Abbreviation,Variable,Weight,NextLevel,IssueCategory,PolicyObjective,EPI Percent. Sample rows: EPI composite (no weight, no NextLevel); PolicyObjective ECO Weight=0.45 NextLevel=EPI; IssueCategory BDH Weight=0.5555556 NextLevel=ECO EPI Percent=25.00%; Indicator MKP Weight=0.12 NextLevel=BDH EPI Percent=3.00%. EPI Percent is the absolute leaf-indicator weight (sums to ~100% across the ~58 indicators) — this is the value for gold_dim_indicator.weight on leaf rows. | WHY leaf-only weights (NULL for aggregates) makes task-055's measure correct: the measure filters source_system='EPI' AND abbrev<>'EPI' (72 sub-indicators = PO + IC + leaf indicators) and does SUMX(score * RELATED(weight)). Aggregates (PO, IC) with NULL weight contribute score*NULL=NULL → excluded from SUMX numerator; SUM(weight) denominator ignores NULLs. Net: weighted average of leaf indicators by EPI Percent = the true EPI composite. No measure rewrite strictly required; optionally harden to type='Indicator' filter for robustness once `type` is real. | DO NOT regress task-055's measure change: the abbrev<>'EPI' filter (exclude the overall composite) and source_system='EPI' filter (exclude WGI) stay. This task adds weights; it does not revisit task-055's double-count fix. | Verification anchor (pre-fix, for contrast): Power BI REST executeQueries (workspace 99e4cc6d-6ec3-49a7-aed9-b69b04a97aa9, dataset f57bdfa4-52c9-47a3-b853-dac1d1f76178) — Weighted EPI Score = BLANK, weight_count_nonblank = 0, type uniformly 'indicator'. Re-query post-fix to confirm weight_count_nonblank > 0, type has 4 distinct values, Weighted EPI Score is a non-blank 0-100 value.

--- COMPLETION (2026-08-04) ---
[Multi-file: 5] AC1: extended bronze_ingest_epi to download epi{epi_year}weights.csv (same retry/HTTP-error pattern as results) and write bronze_epi{epi_year}weights, preserving all 8 source columns (Type, Abbreviation, Variable, Weight, NextLevel, IssueCategory, PolicyObjective, EPI Percent) with schema validation at the bronze gate. AC2: added a silver-build cell in silver-to-gold2 (before dim_indicator) that builds silver_epi{EPI_YEAR}variables from the bronze weights table, mapping weight <- EPI Percent (absolute leaf contribution, load-bearing), carrying nextlevel through; retired the NULL-hardcoding fallback to a loud-warning + empty EPI df (no fake NULL weights); replaced the hardcoded NULL parent_indicator with a self-join on NextLevel == parent.abbrev (root EPI stays NULL, WB stays NULL). AC3: applied the optional measure harden - added gold_dim_indicator[type] = "Indicator" to the EpiSubIndicators filter in fact_epi_score.tmdl (kept task-055's abbrev<>"EPI" filter). Docs: updated external_data_automation.md and dax_measure_library.md. Local Spark verification (spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false): 11/11 assertions pass against an 11-row fixture covering all 4 Type values + a NextLevel parent chain. No src/ mirror exists for EPI ingests/gold_dim_indicator build, so task-032 parity contract unaffected. Deployed-model assertions (AC2/AC3) require fabric-cicd redeploy + Power BI REST executeQueries and are Erik-gated under AC4 - NOT verified locally; did NOT push/deploy/call Fabric APIs.

--- FIX-RETRY (2026-08-04) ---
[Multi-file: 2] VERIFICATION-FAIL-FIX retry (attempt 2 of 3). Fixed both defects verify-agent surfaced against the real Yale CSV. CRITICAL: silver-build cell weight mapping now strips '%' from STRING `EPI Percent` via regexp_replace(...).cast(FloatType()); real CSV stores EPI Percent as '3.00%'/'25.00%' (pd.read_csv keeps StringType at bronze); prior direct cast silently NULLed all 58 leaf weights under ANSI-off. MAJOR: F.when(Type=='Indicator', stripped).otherwise(NULL) NULLs non-leaf rows EXPLICITLY - real CSV has non-null EPI Percent on all 11 IC rows (BDH=25.00% etc.), so the prior 'IC rows carry NULL EPI Percent' claim was wrong; aggregates excluded by (i) this .otherwise(NULL) AND (ii) measure's type='Indicator' filter (untouched) - belt-and-suspenders. MINOR: removed stray ``` fence on L123 of external_data_automation.md. Local verification against REAL epi2024weights.csv (fetched live, 73 rows: 1 EPI + 3 PO + 11 IC + 58 Indicator), EPI Percent as STRING, spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false: 11/11 pass - 58/58 leaf non-null weight (MKP=3.0), 15/15 aggregates NULL incl. all 11 IC, 4 distinct types, 73 in=73 out, EPI root parent=NULL, MKP->BDH match, no cartesian. Did NOT push/deploy/trigger fabric-cicd/call Fabric APIs - AC4 Erik-gated. Non-blocking: task description estimated '2 PO' but real CSV has 3 PO (73=1+3+11+58); code is count-agnostic, not a defect.
